content: AutosarVariableRef With the advent of AutosarVari- ableRef it is possible to implement a uniform reference to a VariableDataProto- type that covers all foreseen use cases: • Reference to a localVariable , no AtpInstanceRef required. • Reference to an autosarVariable (which involves an AtpInstanceRef ). • Reference to the internal structure of a VariableDataPrototype implemented using a composite ImplementationDataType .
